announcements.title: Church Workday
announcements.details: Join us for grounds cleanup and building maintenance. Questions? Ask Andy Barnes or Caleb Mohn.

announcements.title: Fellowship Breakfast
announcements.details: Our first Sunday fellowship breakfast runs from 9:45 to 10:10 a.m. before worship. Everyone is welcome.

announcements.title: Food Pantry
announcements.details: The Andrew County Food Pantry November collection is baking supplies: vanilla, baking powder, baking soda, chocolate chips and the like. Bring one or two any Sunday this month.

announcements.title: Annual Meeting
announcements.details: Our annual FCC business meeting follows the worship service. Please stay for a potluck lunch after the meeting.

announcements.title: Nursing Home Worship
announcements.details: Join us to sing hymns, read Scripture and visit with residents at LaVerna at 2:00 p.m. and Abundant Acres at 3:00 p.m. All ages are welcome. Ask Brenda Barnes if you would like to help or ride along.

announcements.title: Next Sunday
announcements.details: Jesus Provides: in Matthew 14 Jesus feeds the crowd.
